item.title: Subscribe to Microsoft Graph API Notifications with Power Automate
item.description: Learn how to subscribe to Microsoft Graph API notifications using Power Automate to detect Microsoft Entra ID user updates in real time, without backend code.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Power Pages & SPA (Part 2): Adding Authentication with Microsoft Entra ID
item.description: In this second part of the Power Pages & SPA series, we add authentication to our custom React single-page application using Microsoft Entra ID and Power Pages user context.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Power Pages & SPA Part 5: Using Server Logic in React SPA
item.description: How to call Power Pages Server Logic from a React SPA using Microsoft Entra ID app credentials stored in Power Pages site settings and environment variables.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)
